cohort: The study participants were females aged 18-45 years, with cases diagnosed with maternal sepsis and controls being randomly selected females undergoing delivery.
finding: Gestational age below 37 weeks, lack of antenatal booking, and anemia were identified as significant predictors of maternal sepsis, which was associated with a significantly high mortality rate.
gest_age: Mean gestational age was 36.19 +/- 1.84 weeks, with gestational age below 37 weeks identified as a risk factor for sepsis.
